items.title: 13.10 Thande aur garam aabi sodium hydroxide ke saath chlorine ke reactions (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 13.10, printed page 300.

blocks.title: Disproportionation reaction
blocks.text: Woh reaction jis mein ek akela element ek saath oxidation aur reduction dono se guzre disproportionation reaction hai.
Jab chlorine thande aur garam aabi sodium hydroxide se react karti hai to woh disproportionate hoti hai, darja hararat ke mutabiq mukhtalif products banate hue (13.10.1 aur 13.10.2).

blocks.prompt: Disproportionation reaction kya hai? Misal dein (exercise Q.2m).
blocks.explanation: Woh jis mein wahi element ek saath oxidise aur reduce ho. Thande dilute sodium hydroxide mein chlorine, Cl2 + 2NaOH se NaCl + NaClO + H2O, ek hi waqt chloride mein 0 se -1 aur chlorate(I) mein +1 tak jati hai.

items: Chlorine NaOH mein disproportionate hoti hai; products darja hararat par munhasir (thanda: chlorate(I); garam: chlorate(V)).
